author: Mark Atwood
text:
Re-classified workspace-canonical via JMAP-x2gd.84 (2026-05-16). Confirmed: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs lines 370, 378, 945, 953 carry the same as-cast pattern (4 sites; chat-server has 5). Mail-server's limit cast at line 378 already uses the saturating form .min(usize::MAX as u64) per JMAP-x2gd.78 alignment, but the position as usize and the implicit usize -> i64 result casts are still bare 'as' on both crates.

Per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' propagation rule, the fix lands in mail-server first (canonical extension-server template), then propagates here, then to the 6 sibling backends. .53 stays open as chat-server-scope tracking.

Recommendation when this work is picked up: use usize::try_from(i64_val).unwrap_or(usize::MAX) for the i64 -> usize conversions (saturating behavior at the platform-pointer-size boundary) and i64::try_from(usize_val).expect(load-bearing comment about 8 EiB memory bound) for the usize -> i64. Mechanical change; ~5 sites per crate × 8 crates = ~40 sites total.
